analysis_unit: (provider_stratum, model, workload_id, replicate_id) — pairing_key() in study011_analyze.py

derivation.464: 4 conditions x 2 strata x 58 LIVE_VALID per cell (power: two-sided alpha=0.05/4 Bonferroni, power=0.80, h=0.5)
derivation.480: 8 cells x 60 nominal attempts per cell (20 workloads x 3 replicates, all frozen models in the stratum sample)
derivation.619: ceil(464 / 0.75) — assumes 75% LIVE_VALID yield (STUDY-008 3.3% provider-failure rate x3 buffer) => ~77-78 attempts per cell
derivation.890_refuted: The 890 figure in the overnight chat report was an error, not derived from any frozen artifact; it appears in NO repo file. Refuted and replaced by the frozen 480/619 accounting.

derivation.amendment_010_note: Per-cell cap for openrouter cells 5-8 extended 78→156: the 429-burn was quota exhaustion (deterministic provider limitation), not sampling failure. Dialagram cells 1-4 retain their original 78 cap. Global ceiling 931 = 619 + 4×78.

minimum_valid_sample.rule: cell fails viability if LIVE_VALID < 58 at ceiling

provider_failure_allowance.implementation: cell attempts continue past 60 until 58 LIVE_VALID or 78-attempt cap

stopping_rule.per_cell: stop the cell when LIVE_VALID >= 58 (min 58) — never exceed 78 attempts
stopping_rule.global: stop when all 8 cells viable OR total attempts reach 619
stopping_rule.on_non_viable: declare the stratum/cell non-viable; document stopping reason per stratum; NO simulation fallback
stopping_rule.re_run_rule: crash-resume by run_id from checkpoint journal; no double-counting

model_assignment_within_cell.rule: every (workload, replicate) pair in a (stratum, condition) cell is executed against ONE model from the stratum's frozen model set; rotation deterministic from data/study011_replicate_seed_table.json (created at first run, then frozen)
model_assignment_within_cell.rotation: round-robin over the stratum's models: dialagram [deepseek-v4, xiaomi-mimo-2.5, qwen-3.8-max]; openrouter [google/gemma-4-31b-it, z-ai/glm-5.2]
model_assignment_within_cell.note: all models per stratum appear in the sample; analysis unit keeps model in the pairing key
